title: ReadCompleted
description: An asset was read through: metadata out, a machine's reading of it written, and its chunks indexed. Says the asset is now worth searching, and nothing about what it says. Keys are snake_case, not the camelCase the rest of leaf uses: this travels inside a Liquid envelope, whose own fields (event_id, occurred_at, event_type, owner_unit_ref) are snake_case and pinned byte-exact by signed golden vectors. The shape follows the wire.

session_id.description: The working session it was read in. Empty when the asset belongs to none.
